What if you wore a hat every day?
Baseball caps are worn by millions of people every day. People say it makes you go bald. This myth has been around for a long time.

But here's the twist. That's a myth! Hats don't cause hair loss unless they're super tight and pull your hair, and they actually protect your scalp from sunburn! Most hair loss comes from genes, hormones and age, not your cap.
